verdict.rationale: The Minnesota Secretary of State is a government business and lien registry run by the state, and its core product is the authoritative legal filing record. No one can self-host it, so the self-hosting question is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any distributable or self-hostable software. The bulk 'Data and Image Subscriptions' offering is a data feed, not a way to self-host the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
